differences.what: massing: the house seen end-on from the east, its gable toward the eye, the ridge running away up the river and the front slope carried down long and low on the left over the piazza; on the red-edge overlay the build's apex, both stacks and both eave corners land within about 7 px of the drawn ones
stacks: two through the ridge, the near one just behind the east gable's apex (x 1469 px) and the far one further along it (x 1492 px); the build's land within about 4 px

walls: drawn smooth and light on the gable end, as weatherboard reads, in 1820; the build's are squared log. Eight years after the 1812 scene and the earliest picture of the house; the same reading as the 1857, Cram and Teich records, and the same ruling: the 1812 house is built of squared logs (Moses and Kirkland) and Lossing's 1812 view draws them coursed

the house below its eaves: hidden behind a low log building with its own gable in front of it (x 1420-1510 px, y 712-752 px) and a whitewashed house with a door and a window to its right (x 1510-1575 px); the farmstead of 1820, after the Kinzies' return in 1816, which no 1812 source places

the palisade-like fence west of the house with two horses before it (x 1360-1420 px): the farmstead's yard in 1820; the 1812 green and its fence are kinzie_house_1812_green, south of the house, which this view does not see
the tree behind the house's ridge to the north-west (x 1500-1560 px): the cottonwoods are data/flora/plantings/kinzie_house_1812_trees.json; this render is the house alone

east end: two small windows side by side at the eave's height (about x 1442 and 1477 px, y 710-722 px); built (T-2516, end_openings) as two lights with their heads just under the eave, landing within about 6 px of the drawn

piazza roof: the front slope carried down past the gable's eave at a flatter pitch over the posts on the left; rebuilt so (T-2516). The hung roof's eave stood at 2.20 m where the plate draws it level with the back eave's 3.0 m; the swept roof's stands at 2.88 m

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
